record.name: Teacher
record.description: Teachers are masters of education and knowledge sharing. They excel at imparting wisdom, training others in the ways of the Force, and inspiring students to reach their full potential.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A master of education, imparting wisdom to others.

visual_signals.Signal2: Carrying a staff or ceremonial sash

progression_tree.description: You gain the ability to inspire and motivate your students.

effects.notes: When the Teacher strikes a powerful blow, they issue a stern command that makes their enemies more likely to show respect. The consular's presence becomes less intimidating to foes who are already wary of them.

progression_tree.description: You become a master mentor, able to sense your students' strengths and weaknesses.

effects.notes: As the Master Mentor surges, the Teacher's aura of insight focuses and intensifies. They suddenly grasp the subtleties of the situation, gaining proficiency in Insight for a short time.

progression_tree.description: You become a renowned scholar of the Force, able to access ancient tomes and forbidden knowledge.

effects.notes: Upon striking a target, the Consular gains access to a forbidden tome, granting them insight into the mysteries of the Force. The text's secrets are whispered to the Consular's mind, revealing new avenues for study and discovery.

progression_tree.description: You become a wise and venerable sage, able to impart your wisdom upon others.

effects.notes: As the divine power of the Teacher flows through you, a gentle whisper provides insight into the foe's vulnerabilities. The wise one's keen understanding reveals hidden weaknesses, granting advantage on the next attack roll against the hit target.

progression_tree.description: You become a master teacher, able to teach others in the ways of the Force.

effects.notes: As the Consular Teacher focuses their energy, they imbue their opponents with a spark of wisdom. The opponent's attack is momentarily disrupted, allowing the Consular to better anticipate and counter their movements.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: The Teacher assumes a defensive stance, with feet shoulder-width apart and arms raised in a calming gesture, radiating an aura of wisdom and authority.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A gentle, pulsing glow emanates from the Teacher's staff, as if infused with the power of the Force. This soft luminescence underscores their connection to the mystical energies surrounding them.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A venerable Jedi Master stands before a galaxy-spanning library, surrounded by ancient relics and mysterious artifacts.
contextual_modifiers: With subtle hints of holographic projections in the background
